e: Adonoy said to Moshe;
speak, to the kohanim, the sons of Aharon,
and you shall say to them,
let him not defile himself with the dead among his people.
Except to his kin
to whom he is closely related,
for his mother and his father,
for his son, his daughter and for his brother.
For his virgin sister, to whom he is closely related,
who has not yet been married,
for her, he may be defiled.
A husband [An honored one among his people] may not defile himself among his people [for a wife through whom]
he becomes profaned.
They shall not make baldness on their heads
and the corners of their beards they shall not shave,
and they shall not make gashes in their flesh.

h: כִּי֩ אֶת־אִשֵּׁ֨י יְהוָ֜ה לֶ֧חֶם אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֛ם הֵ֥ם מַקְרִיבִ֖ם וְהָ֥יוּ קֹֽדֶשׁ׃
t: אֲרֵי יָת קֻרְבְּנַיָּא דַיְיָ קֻרְבָּן אֱלָהֲהוֹן אִנּוּן מַקְרִיבִין וִיהוֹן קַדִּישִׁין:
e: They shall be holy to [before] their God
and they shall not profane
the Name of their God,
for [it is] the fire-offerings [offerings] of Adonoy, the bread [sacrifice] of their God [that] they bring [offer], and they must [therefore] be holy.
A harlot [One who strays] or a profaned woman they shall not marry.
A woman divorced from her husband they shall not marry,
for he is holy to [before] his God.

t: וּתְקַדְּשִׁנֵּיהּ אֲרֵי יָת קֻרְבַּן אֱלָהָךְ הוּא מְקָרֵב
e: You shall make him holy for he offers the bread [sacrifice] of your God;
he shall be holy unto you
for I, Adonoy, am holy, Who makes you holy.
The daughter of a kohein,
who profanes herself by fornication [straying] —
she profanes her father — [she becomes profane with respect to her father’s holiness]
she shall be burned with fire.

h: וְהַכֹּהֵן֩ הַגָּד֨וֹל מֵאֶחָ֜יו אֲ‍ֽשֶׁר־יוּצַ֥ק עַל־רֹאשׁ֣וֹ שֶׁ֤מֶן הַמִּשְׁחָה֙ וּמִלֵּ֣א אֶת־יָד֔וֹ
t: וְכַהֲנָא דְאִתְרַבָּא מֵאֲחוֹהִי דְּ יִתָּרִיק עַל רֵישֵׁיהּ מִשְׁחָא דִרְבוּתָא וְדִי קָרִיב יָת קֻרְבָּנֵיהּ
e: The kohein who is greatest among his brethren upon whose head was poured the anointing oil [which inaugurates to greatness]; whose hands [sacrifices] were consecrated [offered]
to put on the special garments;
shall not let his hair grow wild
and he shall not tear his garments.

t: וְעַל כָּל נַפְשַׁת מֵתָא לָא יֵיעוֹל
e: And adjacent to any dead body he shall not enter.
For his father and mother he shall not become [ritually] impure.

h: כִּ֡י נֵ֠זֶר שֶׁ֣מֶן מִשְׁחַ֧ת אֱלֹהָ֛יו עָלָ֖יו אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
t: אֲרֵי כְּלִיל מְשַׁח רְבוּתָא דֶאֱלָהֵיהּ עֲלוֹהִי אֲנָא יְיָ:
e: He shall not depart from the Sanctuary
and he shall not profane his Gods Sanctuary,
for the crown of his Gods anointing oil [which inaugurates to greatness] is upon him, I am Adonoy.
He shall marry [only] a virgin.
A widow, divorcee, profaned woman or harlot [one who strays];
he may not marry [any] of these.
But only a virgin from his own people may he marry.
He shall not profane his offspring among his people,
for I am Adonoy, who makes him holy.
Adonoy spoke to Moshe, saying;

h: אִ֣ישׁ מִֽזַּרְעֲךָ֞ לְדֹרֹתָ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִהְיֶ֥ה בוֹ֙ מ֔וּם
t: גְּבַר מִבְּנָיךְ לְדָרֵיהוֹן דִּי יְהֵי בֵיהּ מוּמָא
e: Speak to Aharon saying;
Anyone of your offspring, through [all] their generations who will have a blemish,
shall not approach
to offer the bread [sacrifice] of [before] his God.

h: כִּ֥י כָל־אִ֛ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־בּ֥וֹ מ֖וּם לֹ֣א יִקְרָ֑ב
t: אֲרֵי כָל גְּבַר דִּי בֵיהּ מוּמָא לָא יִקְרָב
e: For any man who has a blemish shall not approach;
a blind man or a lame man,
or a man with a sunken nose, or a man who has disproportionate limbs.
or a man
who has a broken (crippled) foot,
or a broken (crippled) hand,
or one with overhanging eyebrows,
or with a cataract, or a disarrangement [in the eye],
or one with scurf or scabs,
or one with crushed testicles.

h: כָּל־אִ֞ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־בּ֣וֹ מ֗וּם מִזֶּ֙רַע֙ אַהֲרֹ֣ן הַכֹּהֵ֔ן
t: כָּל גְּבַר דִּי בֵיהּ מוּמָא מִזַּרְעָא דְּאַהֲרֹן כַּהֲנָא
e: Any man who has a blemish, who is a descendant of Aharon the kohein,
shall not approach
to offer the fire-offerings [offerings] of Adonoy.
He has a blemish;
the bread [sacrifice] of his God
he may not approach to offer [as an offering].
The bread of his God
which is of the most holy,
and from the holy [offerings] he may eat.

h: אַ֣ךְ אֶל־הַפָּרֹ֜כֶת לֹ֣א יָבֹ֗א וְאֶל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֛חַ לֹ֥א יִגַּ֖שׁ כִּֽי־מ֣וּם בּ֑וֹ
t: בְּרַם לְפָרֻכְתָּא לָא יֵיעוֹל וּלְמַדְבְּחָא לָא יִקְרַב אֲרֵי מוּמָא בֵיהּ
e: However, he may not enter beyond the Curtain and he shall not approach the Altar for he has a blemish
and he shall not profane My holy things,
for I am Adonoy, who sanctifies them.
Moshe spoke [these words]
to Aharon, and to his sons
and to all of Bnei Yisroel.
Adonoy spoke to Moshe, saying;

h: דַּבֵּ֨ר אֶֽל־אַהֲרֹ֜ן וְאֶל־בָּנָ֗יו וְיִנָּֽזְרוּ֙ מִקָּדְשֵׁ֣י בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל
אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֵ֧ם מַקְדִּשִׁ֛ים לִ֖י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
t: מַלֵּיל עִם אַהֲרֹן וְעִם בְּנוֹהִי וְיִפָּרְשׁוּן מִקּוּדְשַׁיָּא דִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל
e: Speak to Aharon and to his sons and let them keep away from the holy offerings of Bnei Yisroel
and they shall not profane My holy name
which they sanctify for [before] Me, I am Adonoy.

h: אֱמֹ֣ר אֲלֵהֶ֗ם לְדֹרֹ֨תֵיכֶ֜ם כָּל־אִ֣ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־יִקְרַ֣ב מִכָּל־זַרְעֲכֶ֗ם אֶל־הַקֳּדָשִׁים֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יַקְדִּ֤ישׁוּ בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה
וְנִכְרְתָ֞ה הַנֶּ֧פֶשׁ הַהִ֛וא מִלְּפָנַ֖י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
t: אֱמַר לְהוֹן לְדָרֵיכוֹן כָּל גְּבַר דִּי יִקְרַב מִכָּל בְּנֵיכוֹן לְקוּדְשַׁיָּא דִּי יְקַדְּשׁוּן בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל קֳדָם יְיָ
וְיִשְׁתֵּיצֵי אֲנָשָׁא הַהִיא מִן קֳדָמַי אֲנָא יְיָ:
e: Say to them; throughout your generations; any person of your offspring who will draw near to the holy things which Bnei Yisroel will sanctify to [before] Adonoy
[while] his impurity is on him
that soul [person] shall be cut off from My Presence, I am Adonoy.

h: אִ֣ישׁ אִ֞ישׁ מִזֶּ֣רַע אַהֲרֹ֗ן וְה֤וּא צָר֙וּעַ֙ א֣וֹ זָ֔ב
t: גְּבַר גְּבַר מִזַּרְעָא דְאַהֲרֹן וְהוּא סְגִיר אוֹ דָאִיב
e: Any man of Aharons offspring; who has tzoraas [the plague of ’confinement’] or an impure flow,
may not eat of the sacred things
until he has purified himself.
[The same is true] of anyone who touches anything defiled by the dead [soul],
or anyone
who has had a seminal emission,
or anyone who touches
any creeping creature that causes impurity to him,
or any person which causes impurity to him,
[with] whatever impurity he has.
Anyone touching [that person]
will be impure until the evening.
He shall not eat of the holy things
unless he has washed his body in water.
When the sun sets, he is pure,
and afterwards, he may eat of the holy things,
for it is his bread.

t: נְבִילָא וּתְבִירָא לָא יֵיכוּל לְאִסְתָּאָבָא בַהּ
e: An animal which has died on its own, or an animal that was fatally maimed, he must not eat to defile himself with it,
I am Adonoy.

t: וְיִטְּרוּן יָת מַטְּרַת מֵימְרִי וְלָא יְקַבְּלוּן עֲלוֹהִי חוֹבָא
e: They shall keep my charge [the charge of My Word] lest they bear [the burden] of sin
and die because of it for having profaned [it].
I am Adonoy Who makes them holy.

t: תּוֹתָבָא דְכַהֲנָא וַאֲגִירָא לָא יֵיכוּל קוּדְשָׁא:
e: No stranger (non-kohein) may eat holy things.
One indentured to a kohein and one hired [by a kohein] may not eat sacred-offerings.

t: וְכָהֵן אֲרֵי יִקְנֵי נְפַשׁ קִנְיַן כַּסְפֵּיהּ
e: If a kohein shall purchase a person [as a slave, that person is] his monetary possession.
He may eat of it,
and the [slave] born in his house,
they may eat of his bread.

t: וּבַת כָּהֵן אֲרֵי תְהֵי לִגְבַר חִלּוֹנָי
e: When a koheins daughter marries a non-kohein,
the sacred terumah [separated] portions may not be eaten by her.

h: וּבַת־כֹּהֵן֩ כִּ֨י תִהְיֶ֜ה אַלְמָנָ֣ה וּגְרוּשָׁ֗ה וְזֶרַע֮ אֵ֣ין לָהּ֒
t: וּבַת כָּהֵן אֲרֵי תְהֵי אַרְמְלָא וּמְתָרְכָא וּבַר לֵית לַהּ
e: If a koheins daughter is either widowed or divorced, and she has no children,
and she returns to her fathers home as in her youth,
she may eat of her fathers bread.
No non-kohein may eat of it.
If a man inadvertently eats of sacred-offering,
he shall add a fifth, to it[s worth]
and give to the kohein the holy thing.
They shall not
profane the holy things of Bnei Yisroel
that which they designated for [before] Adonoy.
They burden them[selves] with the sin of their guilt
when they eat their holy things [in impurity],
for I am Adonoy, Who makes them holy.
Adonoy spoke to Moshe, saying;

h: דַּבֵּ֨ר אֶֽל־אַהֲרֹ֜ן וְאֶל־בָּנָ֗יו וְאֶל֙ כָּל־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל
אִ֣ישׁ אִישׁ֩ מִבֵּ֨ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל וּמִן־הַגֵּ֣ר בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אֲשֶׁ֨ר יַקְרִ֤יב קָרְבָּנוֹ֙ לְכָל־נִדְרֵיהֶם֙ וּלְכָל־נִדְבוֹתָ֔ם
t: מַלֵּיל עִם אַהֲרֹן וְעִם בְּנוֹהִי וְעִם כָּל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל
גְּבַר גְּבַר מִבֵּית יִשָׂרָאֵל וּמִן גִּיּוֹרָא בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל דִּי יְקָרֵב קֻרְבָּנֵיהּ לְכָל נִדְרֵיהוֹן וּלְכָל נִדְבַתְהוֹן
e: Speak to Aharon and to his sons and to all of Bnei Yisroel
and say to them;
any man of the House of Israel, and from the proselytes of Israel who will bring his offering for any of their vows or for any of their free-will-offerings
that they will bring to [before] Adonoy, for a burnt-offering.
To gain acceptance
[it must be] an unblemished male
of cattle, sheep or goats.

t: כֹּל דִּי בֵיהּ מוּמָא לָא תְקָרְבוּן
e: Anything that has a blemish on it you shall not bring,
for it will not be accepted favorably for you.

t: וּגְבַר אֲרֵי יְקָרֵב נִכְסַת קוּדְשַׁיָּא קֳדָם יְיָ
e: If a man will bring a peace[sacred]-offering to [before] Adonoy,
to fulfill an articulated vow or free-will-offering
of cattle or of sheep,
it shall be unblemished, that it be favorably accepted.
No blemish shall be in it.

h: עַוֶּרֶת֩ א֨וֹ שָׁב֜וּר אוֹ־חָר֣וּץ אֽוֹ־יַבֶּ֗לֶת א֤וֹ גָרָב֙ א֣וֹ יַלֶּ֔פֶת
t: עַוִּיר אוֹ תְבִיר אוֹ פְסִיק אוֹ יַבְּלָן אוֹ גַרְבָן אוֹ חֲזָזָן
וְקֻרְבָּנָא לָא תִתְּנוּן מִנְּהוֹן עַל מַדְבְּחָא קֳדָם יְיָ:
e: A blind, broken-limbed, cracked or wart[ed animal]; or [an animal] with scurf or scabs
you shall not bring these to [before] Adonoy;
and as a fire-offering [an offering] you shall not place of them on the altar of [before] Adonoy.
An ox or lamb with one limb larger [or smaller] than the other or with uncleft hooves [one limb smaller than the other],
you shall make (offer) it as a free-will-offering [to the temple treasury] [but]
for [the fulfillment of] a vow it will not be favorably accepted.

t: וְדִי מְרִיס וְדִי רְסִיס וְדִי שְׁלִיף וְדִי גְזִיר
e: [An animal that has its testicles] crushed, mangled, torn or cut off
you shall not bring to [before] Adonoy
and in your land you shall not inflict these injuries.

h: וּמִיַּ֣ד בֶּן־נֵכָ֗ר לֹ֥א תַקְרִ֛יבוּ אֶת־לֶ֥חֶם אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֖ם מִכָּל־אֵ֑לֶּה
t: וּמִן בַּר עַמְמִין לָא תְקָרְבוּן יָת קֻרְבַּן אֱלָהָכוֹן מִכָּל אִלֵּין
e: And from a strangers [gentiles] hand you shall not bring (offer) the bread [offering] of your God from any of these
for they have inflicted wounds in them;
they will not be favorably accepted for you.
Adonoy spoke to Moshe, saying;

t: תּוֹר אוֹ אִמָּר אוֹ עִזָּא אֲרֵי יִתְיְלִיד
e: An ox, lamb or goat, when it is born,
shall be with its mother for seven days.
From the eighth day and thereafter
it may be favorably accepted as a sacrifice as a fire-offering to [an offering before] Adonoy.
An ox [cow] or a [female] lamb,
it and its [her and her] offspring,
you shall not slaughter in one day.
When you sacrifice a thanks-giving-offering to [before] Adonoy,
that it be favorably accepted for you you shall sacrifice it.
On that day [that it is sacrificed] you should eat it;
you shall leave none of it until the next morning,
I am Adonoy.
You shall preserve My commandments
and fulfill them,
I am Adonoy.
You shall not profane My holy Name;
but I will be sanctified among Bnei Yisroel.
I am Adonoy Who makes you holy.
Who brought you out of the land of Egypt
to be your God,
I am Adonoy.
Adonoy spoke to Moshe, saying;

t: מַלֵּיל עִם בְּנֵי יִשְׁרָאֵל וְתֵימַר לְהוֹן
e: Speak to Bnei Yisroel and say to them;
the appointed times of Adonoy,
which you shall proclaim [cause] them [to occur] as holy assemblies [occurrences];
these are My appointed times.
Six days shall work be performed;
and on the seventh day is a Shabbos of resting, a holy assembly [occurrence].
You shall not do any work,
it is a Shabbos for [before] Adonoy
in all your dwelling places.
These are the appointed times of Adonoy,
the holy assemblies [occurrences]
that you shall proclaim [cause] them [to occur] in their appointed times.

h: בַּחֹ֣דֶשׁ הָרִאשׁ֗וֹן בְּאַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָׂ֛ר לַחֹ֖דֶשׁ בֵּ֣ין הָעַרְבָּ֑יִם
t: בְּיַרְחָא קַדְמָאָה בְּאַרְבְּעַת עַשְׂרָא לְיַרְחָא בֵּין שִׁמְשַׁיָּא
e: In the first month (Nisan), on the fourteenth day of the month in the afternoon,
is a Pesach (offering) for [before] Adonoy.
On the fifteenth day of this month
is the festival of matzos, for [before] Adonoy;
for seven days you shall eat matzos [matzoh].
On the first day
[there] shall be a day of holy assembly [occurrence] for you;
you shall not do any work of labor.
You shall bring a fire-offering to [an offering before] Adonoy [on each of] seven days.
On the seventh day it is [a day] of holy assembly [occurrence];
you shall not do any work of labor.
Adonoy spoke to Moshe, saying,

h: כִּֽי־תָבֹ֣אוּ אֶל־הָאָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֤ר אֲנִי֙ נֹתֵ֣ן לָכֶ֔ם
t: מַלֵּיל עִם בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְתֵימַר לְהוֹן
אֲרֵי תֵעֲלוּן לְאַרְעָא דִּי אֲנָא יָהֵב לְכוֹן
וְתַיְתוּן יָת עוּמְרָא רֵישׁ חֲצָדְכוֹן לְוָת כַּהֲנָא:
e: Speak to Bnei Yisroel and say to them;
when you come into the land that I give to you
and you reap its harvest,
you shall bring an omer of the first fruits of your harvest to the kohein.

t: וִירִים יָת עוּמְרָא קֳדָם יְיָ לְרַעֲוָא לְכוֹן
e: He shall wave [lift up] the omer before Adonoy that it be favorably accepted for you.
On the day after the day of rest (Pesach),
the kohein shall wave [lift] it [up].

t: אִמַּר שְׁלִים בַּר שַׁתֵּיהּ לַעֲלָתָא קֳדָם יְיָ:
e: You shall prepare, on the day when you wave [lift] the omer,
an unblemished, male, yearling lamb as a burnt-offering, to [before] Adonoy.

h: וּמִנְחָתוֹ֩ שְׁנֵ֨י עֶשְׂרֹנִ֜ים סֹ֣לֶת בְּלוּלָ֥ה בַשֶּׁ֛מֶן אִשֶּׁ֥ה לַיהוָ֖ה רֵ֣יחַ נִיחֹ֑חַ
t: וּמִנְחָתֵיהּ תְּרֵין עֶשְׁרוֹנִין סֻלְתָּא דְּפִילָא בִמְשַׁח קֻרְבָּנָא קֳדָם יְיָ לְאִתְקַבָּלָא בְרַעֲוָא
e: Its meal-offering is two tenths of flour mixed with [olive] oil as a fire-offering to [an offering before] Adonoy of pleasing fragrance [to be accepted with favor].
Its wine-offering is one fourth of a hin.

h: וְלֶחֶם֩ וְקָלִ֨י וְכַרְמֶ֜ל לֹ֣א תֹֽאכְל֗וּ עַד־עֶ֙צֶם֙ הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֔ה
t: וּלְחֵם וּקְלִי וּפֵרוּכָן לָא תֵיכְלוּן עַד כְּרַן יוֹמָא הָדֵין
e: Bread, parched grain or tender [ground] grain you shall not eat until this very day,
until you bring the offering of your God;
it is an everlasting statute for all your generations
in all your dwelling places.
You shall count for yourselves, from the day after the day of rest (Pesach)
from the day on which you will bring
the omer waveuplifted-offering,
seven complete weeks they shall be,
Until the day after the seventh week,
you shall count fifty days,
and you shall bring a new meal-offering to [before] Adonoy.

h: מִמּוֹשְׁבֹ֨תֵיכֶ֜ם תָּבִ֣יאּוּ לֶ֣חֶם תְּנוּפָ֗ה שְׁ֚תַּיִם שְׁנֵ֣י עֶשְׂרֹנִ֔ים
t: מִמּוֹתְבָנֵיכוֹן תַּיְתוּן לְחֵם אֲרָמוּתָא תַּרְתֵּין (גְּרִיצַן) תְּרֵין עֶשְׁרוֹנִין
e: From [the land of] your dwelling places you shall bring two bread wave[uplifted]-offerings;
of two tenths of flour they shall be.
You shall bake them leavened,
as first-fruit-offering to [before] Adonoy.

h: וְהִקְרַבְתֶּ֣ם עַל־הַלֶּ֗חֶם שִׁבְעַ֨ת כְּבָשִׂ֤ים תְּמִימִם֙ בְּנֵ֣י שָׁנָ֔ה
t: וּתְקָרְבוּן עַל לַחְמָא שִׁבְעָא אִמְּרִין שַׁלְמִין בְּנֵי שְׁנָא
וְתוֹר בַּר תּוֹרֵי חַד וְדִכְרִין תְּרֵין
e: You shall bring, along with the bread, seven unblemished, yearling lambs,
one young bullock and two rams;
they shall be a burnt-offering to [before] Adonoy
with their meal-offerings and wine-offerings,
a fire-offering of pleasing fragrance to [an offering which is accepted with favor before] Adonoy.

h: וּשְׁנֵ֧י כְבָשִׂ֛ים בְּנֵ֥י שָׁנָ֖ה לְזֶ֥בַח שְׁלָמִֽים׃
t: וְתַעְבְּדוּן צְפִיר בַּר עִזֵּי חַד לְחַטָּאתָא
e: You shall prepare one he-goat as a sin-offering
and two yearling lambs as peace[sacred]-offerings.

h: וְהֵנִ֣יף הַכֹּהֵ֣ן אֹתָ֡ם עַל֩ לֶ֨חֶם הַבִּכּוּרִ֤ים תְּנוּפָה֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה
t: וִירִים כַּהֲנָא יָתְהוֹן עַל לְחֵם בִּכּוּרַיָּא אֲרָמוּתָא קֳדָם יְיָ
e: The kohein shall wave [lift] them [up] along with the bread of the first-fruit-offering as a wave-offering [an uplifted-offering] before Adonoy
with the two lambs;
they shall be holy for [before] Adonoy, for the kohein.

h: וּקְרָאתֶ֞ם בְּעֶ֣צֶם הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֗ה מִֽקְרָא־קֹ֙דֶשׁ֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֔ם
t: וּתְעָרְעוּן בִּכְרַן יוֹמָא הָדֵין מְעָרַע קַדִּישׁ יְהֵי לְכוֹן
e: You shall proclaim [cause to occur] on this very day; it shall be a [day of] holy assembly [occurrence] for you
you shall not do any work of labor.
It is an everlasting statute in all your dwelling places throughout your generations.

h: וּֽבְקֻצְרְכֶ֞ם אֶת־קְצִ֣יר אַרְצְכֶ֗ם לֹֽא־תְכַלֶּ֞ה פְּאַ֤ת שָֽׂדְךָ֙ בְּקֻצְרֶ֔ךָ
t: וּבְמֶחֱצָדְכוֹן יָת חֲצָדָא דְאַרְעֲכוֹן לָא תְשֵׁיצֵי פָּאתָא דְחַקְלָךְ בְּמֶחֱצָדָךְ
e: When you reap the harvest of your land, you shall not cut completely the corner of your field when you reap.
You shall not gather the gleaning of your harvest.
You shall leave them for the poor and the proselyte,
I am Adonoy, your God.
Adonoy spoke to Moshe, saying;

h: בַּחֹ֨דֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֜י בְּאֶחָ֣ד לַחֹ֗דֶשׁ יִהְיֶ֤ה לָכֶם֙ שַׁבָּת֔וֹן
t: בְּיַרְחָא שְׁבִיעָאָה בְּחַד לְיַרְחָא יְהֵי לְכוֹן נְיָחָא
e: Speak to Bnei Yisroel, saying;
in the seventh month, on the first of the month, shall be for you a [day of] rest.
A remembrance of the sounding [crying] [of the shofor], a holy assembly [occurrence].
You shall not do any work of labor
and you shall bring a fire-offering to [an offering before] Adonoy.
Adonoy spoke to Moshe, saying;

h: אַ֡ךְ בֶּעָשׂ֣וֹר לַחֹדֶשׁ֩ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֨י הַזֶּ֜ה י֧וֹם הַכִּפֻּרִ֣ים ה֗וּא מִֽקְרָא־קֹ֙דֶשׁ֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֔ם
t: בְּרַם בְּעַשְׂרָא לְיַרְחָא שְׁבִיעָאָה הָדֵין יוֹמָא דְכִפּוּרַיָּא הוּא מְעָרַע קַדִּישׁ יְהֵי לְכוֹן
e: Indeed, on the tenth day of this seventh month is a day of atonement. It shall be for you a [day of] holy assembly [occurrence]
and you shall afflict yourselves
and you shall bring a fire-offering to [an offering before] Adonoy.
You shall not do any work
on this very day,
for it is a day of atonements,
to atone for you
before Adonoy, your God.

t: אֲרֵי כָל אֲנָשָׁא דִּי לָא מִתְעַנֵּי
e: For any person who will not be afflicted
on this very day
shall be cut off from his people.

t: וְכָל אֱנַשׁ דִּי תַעְבֵּד כָּל עִבִידָא
וְאוֹבֵד יָת אֲנָשָׁא הַהִיא מִגּוֹ עַמַּהּ:
e: Any person who does any work
on this very day,
I will cause that person to perish from among his people.
You shall not do any work;
it is an everlasting statute for all your generations
in all your dwelling places.
It is a Shabbos of complete rest for you
and you shall afflict yourselves
on the ninth day of the month at evening;
from evening to evening
you shall rest, on your day of rest.
Adonoy spoke to Moshe, saying;

h: בַּחֲמִשָּׁ֨ה עָשָׂ֜ר י֗וֹם לַחֹ֤דֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִי֙ הַזֶּ֔ה
t: בְּחַמְשָׁא עַשְׁרָא יוֹמָא לְיַרְחָא שְׁבִיעָאָה הָדֵין
e: Speak to Bnei Yisroel saying;
on the fifteenth day of this seventh month is
the festival of [shelters] Sukkos for seven days, for [before] Adonoy.
On the first day [there shall be] a holy assembly [occurrence];
you shall not do any work of labor.

h: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁמִינִ֡י מִקְרָא־קֹדֶשׁ֩ יִהְיֶ֨ה לָכֶ֜ם וְהִקְרַבְתֶּ֨ם אִשֶּׁ֤ה לַֽיהוָה֙ עֲצֶ֣רֶת הִ֔וא
t: בְּיוֹמָא תְמִינָאָה מְעָרַע קַדִּישׁ יְהֵי לְכוֹן וּתְקָרְבוּן קֻרְבָּנָא קֳדָם יְיָ כְּנֵשׁ תְּהוֹן
e: For seven days,
you shall bring a fire-offering to [an offering before] Adonoy;
the eighth day shall be for you a holy assembly [occurrence], and you shall bring a fire-offering to [an offering before] Adonoy. It is [a day] of convocation.
you shall not do any work of labor.

h: לְהַקְרִ֨יב אִשֶּׁ֜ה לַיהוָ֗ה עֹלָ֧ה וּמִנְחָ֛ה זֶ֥בַח וּנְסָכִ֖ים דְּבַר־י֥וֹם בְּיוֹמֽוֹ׃
t: לְקָרָבָא קֻרְבָּנָא קֳדָם יְיָ עֲלָתָא וּמִנְחָתָא נִכְסַת קוּדְשִׁין וְנִסּוּכִין פִּתְגַם יוֹם בְּיוֹמֵיהּ:
e: These are the appointed times of Adonoy
which you shall proclaim [cause] them [to occur] [as] holy assemblies [occurrences],
on which to bring a fire-offering to [an offering before] Adonoy; a burnt-offering and a meal-offering, a [sacred-]sacrifice and wine-offerings, each on its assigned day,

h: וּמִלְּבַ֣ד מַתְּנֽוֹתֵיכֶ֗ם וּמִלְּבַ֤ד כָּל־נִדְרֵיכֶם֙ וּמִלְּבַד֙ כָּל־נִדְב֣וֹתֵיכֶ֔ם
t: וּבַר מַתְּנָתֵיכוֹן וּבַר כָּל נִדְרֵיכוֹן וּבַר כָּל נִדְבָתֵיכוֹן
e: Besides the [offerings of the] Shabbasos of Adonoy
and besides your gifts and besides all your vow-offerings and besides all your free-will-offerings
that you will give to [before] Adonoy.

h: אַ֡ךְ בַּחֲמִשָּׁה֩ עָשָׂ֨ר י֜וֹם לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֗י בְּאָסְפְּכֶם֙ אֶת־תְּבוּאַ֣ת הָאָ֔רֶץ
t: בְּרַם בְּחַמְשָׁא עֲשַׁר יוֹמָא לְיַרְחָא שְׁבִיעָאָה בְּמִכְנְשֵׁיכוֹן יָת עֲלַלַת אַרְעָא
תְּחַגּוּן יָת חַגָּא קֳדָם יְיָ שִׁבְעָא יוֹמִין
e: Indeed, on the fifteenth day of the seventh month, when you gather the produce of the land
you shall celebrate the festival of [before] Adonoy for seven days.
The first day is a day of rest
and the eighth day is a day of rest.

h: וּלְקַחְתֶּ֨ם לָכֶ֜ם בַּיּ֣וֹם הָרִאשׁ֗וֹן פְּרִ֨י עֵ֤ץ הָדָר֙ כַּפֹּ֣ת תְּמָרִ֔ים
וּשְׂמַחְתֶּ֗ם לִפְנֵ֛י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֖ם שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִֽים׃
t: וְתִסְּבוּן לְכוֹן בְּיוֹמָא קַדְמָאָה פֵּרֵי אִילָנָא אֶתְרוֹגִין וְלֻלַּבִּין
וְתֶחֱדוּן קֳדָם יְיָ אֱלָהָכוֹן שַׁבְעַת יוֹמִין:
e: You shall take for yourselves, on the first day, the fruit of the beautiful tree (esrog) [esrogim], a branch of palm trees (lulav) [lulavim],
boughs of thick-leaved trees (hadasim), and willows of the brook (aravos),
and you shall rejoice before Adonoy, your God, for seven days.
You shall celebrate it as a festival to [before] Adonoy
seven days in the year;
it is an everlasting statute throughout your generations
in the seventh month, you shall celebrate it.
You shall dwell in the [shelters] sukkos seven days,
every native born [settled] Israelite
shall dwell in the [shelters] sukkos.

t: אֲרֵי בִמְטַלָּיוּת עֲנָנֵי אוֹתֵבִית יָת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל
e: So that your generations will know
that in the [clouds of shelter] sukkos I caused Bnei Yisroel to dwell
when I took them out from the land of Egypt,
I am Adonoy, your God.
And thus Moshe declared
the [order of the] appointed times of Adonoy
[and taught them] to Bnei Yisroel.
Adonoy spoke to Moshe, saying;

h: צַ֞ו אֶת־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וְיִקְח֨וּ אֵלֶ֜יךָ שֶׁ֣מֶן זַ֥יִת זָ֛ךְ כָּתִ֖ית לַמָּא֑וֹר
t: פַּקֵּד יָת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְיִסְּבוּן לָךְ מְשַׁח זֵיתָא דַכְיָא כָּתִישָׁא לְאַנְהָרָא
e: Command Bnei Yisroel to take (bring) to you pure, pressed, olive oil for illumination
to keep the lamp [lamps] burning constantly.

h: מִחוּץ֩ לְפָרֹ֨כֶת הָעֵדֻ֜ת בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֗ד יַעֲרֹךְ֩ אֹת֨וֹ אַהֲרֹ֜ן מֵעֶ֧רֶב עַד־בֹּ֛קֶר לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה תָּמִ֑יד
t: מִבָּרָא לְפָרֻכְתָּא דְסַהֲדוּתָא בְּמַשְׁכַּן זִמְנָא יַסְדַּר יָתֵיהּ אֲהֲרֹן מֵרַמְשָׁא עַד צַפְרָא קֳדָם יְיָ תְּדִירָא
e: Outside of the Curtain of the Testimony, which is inside the Tent of Meeting, Aharon shall arrange it [so that it burns] from evening until morning before Adonoy, continually;
as an everlasting statute throughout your generations.
Atop the pure menorah
he shall arrange the lights
before Adonoy, constantly.
You shall take fine flour
and bake twelve loaves,
each individual loaf shall be two tenths [of an ephah].

h: וְשַׂמְתָּ֥ אוֹתָ֛ם שְׁתַּ֥יִם מַֽעֲרָכ֖וֹת שֵׁ֣שׁ הַֽמַּעֲרָ֑כֶת
t: וּתְשַׁוִּי יָתְהוֹן תַּרְתֵּין סִדְרִין שִׁית סִדְרָא
e: You shall place them in two stacks, six in each stack
on the Pure Table, before Adonoy.
You shall put pure frankincense on [each] stack
and it shall be as a memorial portion for the bread,
as a fire-offering, to [an offering before] Adonoy.

h: בְּי֨וֹם הַשַּׁבָּ֜ת בְּי֣וֹם הַשַּׁבָּ֗ת יַֽעַרְכֶ֛נּוּ לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה תָּמִ֑יד
t: בְּיוֹמָא דְשַׁבְּתָא בְּיוֹמָא דְשַׁבְּתָא יַסְדְּרִנֵּיהּ קֳדָם יְיָ תְּדִירָא
מִן קֳדָם בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל קְיַם עָלָם:
e: On each and every Shabbos he shall arrange them before Adonoy, continually,
from [before] Bnei Yisroel as an eternal covenant.

h: כִּ֡י קֹדֶשׁ֩ קָֽדָשִׁ֨ים ה֥וּא ל֛וֹ מֵאִשֵּׁ֥י יְהוָ֖ה חָק־עוֹלָֽם׃
t: אֲרֵי קֹדֶשׁ קוּדְשִׁין הוּא לֵיהּ מִקֻּרְבָּנַיָּא דַיְיָ קְיַם עָלָם:
e: It shall belong to Aharon and to his sons
and they shall eat it in a sacred place,
for it is most holy for him from among the fire-offerings [offerings] of Adonoy, as an everlasting statute.
The son of an Israelite woman went out,
and he was the son of an Egyptian man,
among Bnei Yisroel.
They argued in the encampment —
the son of the Israelite woman,
and the Israelite man.

t: וּפָרֵשׁ בַּר אִתְּתָא בַת יִשְׂרָאֵל יָת שְׁמָא וְאַרְגֵּז
וְשׁוּם אִמֵּיהּ שְׁלֹּמִית בַּת דִּבְרִי לְשִׁבְטָא דְדָן:
e: The Israelite womans son clearly pronounced the Name [of God] and blasphemed [caused anger]
and they brought him to Moshe.
The name of his mother was Shlomis, daughter of Divri of the tribe of Dan.

t: עַד דְּיִתְפָּרַשׁ לְהוֹן עַל גְּזֵרַת מֵימְרָא דַיְיָ:
e: They placed [bound] him in the guardhouse
until [his penalty] would be explained to them through the [law of the] word of Adonoy.
Adonoy spoke to Moshe, saying;

t: וְיִסְמְכוּן כָּל דִּי שְׁמָעוּ יָת יְדֵיהוֹן עַל רֵישֵׁיהּ
e: Take the blasphemer [one who has caused anger] beyond the encampment,
and all those who heard him shall lay their hands on his head
and the entire congregation shall stone him.

h: אִ֥ישׁ אִ֛ישׁ כִּֽי־יְקַלֵּ֥ל אֱלֹהָ֖יו וְנָשָׂ֥א חֶטְאֽוֹ׃
t: גְּבַר גְּבַר דִּי יַרְגֵּז קֳדָם אֱלָהֵיהּ וִיקַבֵּל חוֹבֵיהּ:
e: And to Bnei Yisroel you shall speak, saying;
Any person who shall blaspheme [cause anger before] his God shall bear [the burden of] his sin.

t: וְדִי פָרֵשׁ שְׁמָא דַיְיָ אִתְקְטָלָא יִתְקְטֵל
e: Whoever pronounces clearly the Name of Adonoy [and blasphemes] he will surely be put to death.
The entire congregation shall surely stone him.
The proselyte and native born [settled one] alike
when he clearly articulates the Name, shall be put to death.

t: וּגְבַר אֲרֵי יִקְטוֹל כָּל נַפְשָׁא דַאֲנָשָׁא
e: Any man who kills any human being
must surely be put to death.
Whoever kills an animal shall pay for it,
[the compensation of] an animal for an animal.
A man who maims his neighbor
just as he did,
so shall be done to him.
[Compensation for] a broken bone [in exchange] for a broken bone,
[compen-sation for] the loss of an eye [in exchange] for the loss of an eye,
[compensation for] the loss to a tooth [in exchange] for the loss of a tooth;
just as he maimed the man,
so shall it be done to him [monetarily].
Whoever smites [kills] an animal shall pay for it.
Whoever smites [kills] a person shall be put to death.
One rule shall apply for all of you
just as it is for the proselyte, so it shall be for the native born [settled one],
for I am Adonoy, your God.

t: כְּמָא דִי פַקֵּיד יְיָ יָת משֶׁה:
e: Moshe spoke to Bnei Yisroel
and they took the blasphemer [one who caused anger], beyond the encampment
and they stoned him with a stone.
And Bnei Yisroel did
just as Adonoy commanded Moshe.
